plan.title: Closed RFQ Extend Time Without Selection

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ instead of creating or searching for an event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Keep post-expiry surrogate bidding disabled as required.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case configuration.
Keep evaluation reopening restricted as required.
Reach the RFQ Responses view where the stage Settings menu is available.
Open Increase Event Time and press Ok with no duration selected or entered; the step asserts Procol refuses the submission.
